title: Learning uncertainty fields for joint brain stroke diagnosis and intrinsic lesion localization in CT and MRI
zh_title: 不确定性场用于CT/MRI脑卒中诊断与病灶定位
summary: 提出DFE-Net，利用可学习模糊隶属场表达空间不确定性，联合进行卒中分类与病灶定位，在多中心CT与小规模MRI队列上评估。
key_points: MRI队列67例，AUC 0.978，F1 0.879
CT病灶定位对专家标注Dice为0.70
reason: 多中心CT较大样本但摘要未见外部验证，MRI样本小，属值得一看档
abstract: Early stroke changes can be difficult to detect and localize on neuroimaging, particularly when lesion boundaries are indistinct. We developed the Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network (DFE-Net), which uses learnable fuzzy membership fields to represent spatial uncertainty and jointly classify stroke and localize lesions. We evaluated the model on a multicentre computed tomography (CT) cohort comprising 6650 patients and 8873 images and a separate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) cohort comprising 67 patients and 615 images. Training and testing were performed separately within each modality. DFE-Net achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.974 and an F1 score of 0.897 on CT, and corresponding values of 0.978 and 0.879 on MRI. In the CT cohort, lesion localization against expert annotations yielded a Dice score of 0.70. MRI localization was assessed using gradient-derived pseudo-targets because expert lesion masks were unavailable. Expected calibration error was ~0.022 in both cohorts, and the model contained 0.20 million parameters. These results support joint diagnosis and spatial localization with a compact model, while prospective validation and expert-annotated MRI evaluation remain necessary.
zh_abstract: 早期卒中改变在神经影像上可能难以检测和定位，尤其是在病灶边界不清时。我们开发了动态模糊编码器网络（Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network，DFE-Net），该模型利用可学习的模糊隶属度场来表示空间不确定性，并同时进行卒中分类和病灶定位。我们在一个多中心计算机断层扫描（CT）队列（6650 例患者、8873 幅图像）和一个独立的磁共振成像（MRI）队列（67 例患者、615 幅图像）上评估了该模型。训练和测试在每种成像模态内分别进行。DFE-Net 在 CT 上的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.974，F1 分数为 0.897；在 MRI 上相应数值分别为 0.978 和 0.879。在 CT 队列中，以专家标注为参照的病灶定位 Dice 得分为 0.70。由于缺少专家病灶掩膜，MRI 的定位采用梯度衍生的伪目标进行评估。两个队列的期望校准误差均约为 0.022，模型包含 0.20 百万个参数。这些结果支持使用紧凑模型同时完成诊断和空间定位，但仍需进行前瞻性验证以及基于专家标注的 MRI 评估。

title: Measurement fidelity and external validation of automated breast DCE-MRI segmentation
zh_title: 乳腺DCE-MRI自动分割的测量保真度与外部验证
summary: 提出增强感知的3D MedNeXt框架，在多队列回顾性设计中以测量保真度为主要终点，评估肿瘤体积与直径误差，并含外部验证与放射科医生评阅。
key_points: 521例配对样本中肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%
体积ICC为0.97，最大直径ICC为0.80
内部Dice 0.831，DUKE留出层0.823
reason: 回顾性多队列含外部验证与医生评阅，强调测量保真度，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated breast dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) segmentation could facilitate quantitative tumor measurement, but geometric overlap alone does not establish the fidelity of mask-derived measurements. We developed an enhancement-aware three-dimensional MedNeXt framework with gated skip fusion and boundary supervision and evaluated it in a retrospective multi-cohort design spanning locked internal testing, source-held-out assessment, retrospective external validation, and radiologist review. Measurement fidelity was the primary endpoint. Across 521 paired internal-test and DUKE cases, median errors were 9.7% for tumor volume, 1.8 mm for 3D maximum surface diameter, and 10.2% for operational enhancement-defined volume, with corresponding ICCs of 0.97, 0.80, and 0.97. Median Dice was 0.831 internally and 0.823 in the DUKE source-held-out stratum, and was 0.812 and 0.806 in the BC-MRI-SEG and public BreastDCEDL_AMBL retrospective external-validation cohorts, respectively, using the frozen checkpoint without external-label tuning. No major correction was required for 78 of 80 masks in the blinded two-reader review. In 276 paired response-analysis cases, AUROC was 0.732 with automatic geometry and 0.757 with expert geometry (difference, −0.025; 95% CI, −0.095 to 0.045); discrimination non-inferiority was not demonstrated. These findings support automated segmentation as a starting point for radiologist-supervised retrospective quantitative research within the evaluated cohorts, while distinguishing measurement fidelity from downstream predictive equivalence.

title: HGS-BioAbductor: hypergraph-based explainable survival modelling and LLM-based biological hypothesis abduction
zh_title: HGS-BioAbductor：超图可解释生存模型与LLM生物学假设推演
summary: 提出超图神经网络生存预测框架，并用多智能体LLM从XAI结果推演分子机制假设；在18个蛋白质组/转录组数据集中16个取得最高C-index。
key_points: 超图网络在18个数据集中16个C-index最高
多智能体锦标赛生成机制假设
借助文献检索评估假设合理性与新颖性
reason: 多数据集对比充分的预后方法，结合智能体假设发现；缺乏前瞻验证
abstract: Explainable deep survival modeling remains challenging due to the performance-explainability trade-off in prognostic models and the gap between feature importance and biological abduction. To address these limitations, we present HGS-BioAbductor, a framework that first constructs a biologically embedded hypergraph neural network for accurate survival prediction. Then, from predictive biomarkers and pathways identified by eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), it leverages a multi-agent-based tournament process to derive novel molecular mechanisms, and the plausibility and novelty of all hypotheses are quantitatively assessed with automatically queried literature. Across 18 independent clinical proteomics/transcriptomics datasets, HGS achieved the highest C-index in 16/18 benchmarks compared to seven other baselines and outperformed interpretable counterparts by a large margin (+0.1-0.2 C-index). Furthermore, in a case study of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), the system demonstrates its ability to propose new hypotheses about previously underexplored proteins in HCC prognosis, e.g., PFKFB2, with strong plausibility in the literature (>0.8), and knockdown experiments in Huh7 and MHCC-LM3 cell lines confirmed that PFKFB2 promotes HCC cell proliferation and colony formation. This work bridges data-driven omics discovery with biological interpretability supported by literature, offering an automated and end-to-end paradigm for clinical omics analysis.
zh_abstract: 可解释的深度生存建模仍然具有挑战性，原因在于预后模型中性能与可解释性之间的权衡，以及特征重要性与生物学溯因推理之间的差距。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 HGS-BioAbductor 框架，该框架首先构建一个嵌入生物学信息的超图神经网络，用于准确的生存预测。随后，基于可解释人工智能（XAI）识别出的预测性生物标志物和通路，利用基于多智能体的锦标赛流程推导新的分子机制，并通过自动检索的文献对所有假设的合理性和新颖性进行定量评估。在 18 个独立的临床蛋白质组学/转录组学数据集中，与其他七种基线方法相比，HGS 在 16/18 个基准测试中取得了最高的 C-index，并大幅优于可解释的对照方法（C-index 高出 0.1–0.2）。此外，在肝细胞癌（HCC）的案例研究中，该系统展示了针对 HCC 预后中此前研究不足的蛋白质提出新假设的能力，例如 PFKFB2，其在文献中的合理性较强（>0.8）；在 Huh7 和 MHCC-LM3 细胞系中的敲低实验证实 PFKFB2 促进 HCC 细胞增殖和集落形成。这项工作将数据驱动的组学发现与文献支持的生物学可解释性相结合，为临床组学分析提供了一种自动化的端到端范式。

title: DPI-score: a deep learning-based metric for assessing protein-protein interfaces in cryoEM derived assemblies
zh_title: DPI-score：评估冷冻电镜组装体蛋白界面的深度学习指标
summary: 提出仅用界面原子坐标的深度学习指标DPI-Score，验证准确率87.53%，并应用于EMDB中分辨率差于3 Å的6,011个条目的29,120个界面。
key_points: 仅用原始界面原子坐标，无需人工特征
验证准确率87.53%
应用于EMDB 29,120个界面
reason: 新方法且应用规模较大，但属结构生物学工具，未见独立外部验证细节
abstract: Advances in cryoEM have led to a surge in high-resolution structures; however, model building and refinement at resolutions ( > = 3 Å) and in regions with variable local resolution remain challenging, making validation essential. CryoEM derived assemblies often contain extensive protein-protein interfaces, however, most existing validation metrics focus on density fit or overall geometry without directly assessing interface quality. To address this, we present DPI-Score, a deep learning-based metric for assessing protein-protein interfaces in cryoEM derived complexes. The method uses only raw structural coordinates of interface atoms, without requiring engineered features, and achieves 87.53% validation accuracy. DPI-Score was applied to 29,120 interfaces from 6,011 fitted entries with resolutions worse than 3 Å in the Electron Microscopy Data Bank. Here, we show that DPI-Score provides complementary information to existing validation metrics and can identify interface errors in modelled assemblies that are not detected by density-based scores alone.
zh_abstract: 冷冻电镜（cryoEM）技术的进步带来了高分辨率结构的激增；然而，在分辨率（≥3 Å）以及局部分辨率存在差异的区域，模型构建和精修仍具挑战性，因此验证至关重要。冷冻电镜解析得到的组装体往往包含广泛的蛋白质-蛋白质界面，但现有大多数验证指标侧重于密度拟合或整体几何结构，并未直接评估界面质量。为此，我们提出了 DPI-Score，这是一种基于深度学习、用于评估冷冻电镜解析复合物中蛋白质-蛋白质界面的指标。该方法仅使用界面原子的原始结构坐标，无需人工设计的特征，验证准确率达 87.53%。我们将 DPI-Score 应用于电子显微镜数据库（Electron Microscopy Data Bank）中分辨率低于 3 Å 的 6,011 个拟合条目的 29,120 个界面。结果表明，DPI-Score 能够提供与现有验证指标互补的信息，并可识别出仅依靠基于密度的评分无法检出的、模型化组装体中的界面错误。

title: Beyond skin deep: physiologic oral pigmentation as an overlooked validation gap in AI-assisted oral cancer screening

abstract: AI-assisted oral cancer screening tools, exemplified by MeMoSA, have been validated almost exclusively in Asian populations. We propose a testable hypothesis: physiologic oral pigmentation, which varies by race independent of pathology, may cause classifiers to misclassify normal variation as suspicious or miss camouflaged lesions. Following precedent from pulse oximetry and dermatology AI, we call for pigmentation-stratified validation before deployment in racially diverse settings such as the United States.
zh_abstract: 以 MeMoSA 为代表的人工智能辅助口腔癌筛查工具几乎仅在亚洲人群中得到验证。我们提出一个可检验的假说：生理性口腔色素沉着因种族而异，且与病理无关，可能导致分类器将正常变异误判为可疑，或漏诊被掩盖的病变。参照脉搏血氧测定和皮肤科人工智能的先例，我们呼吁在美国等种族多样的环境中部署之前，先进行按色素沉着分层的验证。

title: Learning health system frameworks and the integration of artificial intelligence and data science in United States health care: a scoping review
zh_title: 美国学习型医疗系统框架与AI/数据科学整合：范围综述
summary: 范围综述纳入54项LHS框架研究和30项AI/数据科学研究，梳理框架共有组成及AI整合情况。
key_points: 检索2007年1月至2025年8月美国研究
54项框架研究，其中56%为真实实施
归纳出数据基础设施、治理等反复出现的组件
reason: 范围综述，仅限美国，泛化性有限
abstract: Learning Health Systems (LHSs) use routinely collected data to generate evidence that informs practice through continuous learning cycles. Artificial intelligence (AI) and data science may strengthen this model, but how LHS frameworks and AI applications relate remains unclear. We mapped LHS frameworks and their components and examined how AI and data science are integrated. Searches identified U.S.-based, English-language studies published January 2007–August 2025; two reviewers independently screened and extracted data, resolving disagreements by consensus. We included 54 framework studies (24 [44%] conceptual adaptations; 30 [56%] real-world implementations) and 30 AI/data science studies. Five components recurred across the frameworks: data infrastructure and interoperability, governance and stakeholder engagement, learning and improvement cycles, evidence generation and translation, and equity and ethics. Relative to framework studies, AI studies less often addressed governance and stakeholder engagement (17% vs 35%) or equity (13% vs 22%), emphasizing computational over organizational functions. Most AI studies (27/30) focused on the data-to-knowledge phase; only three extended to knowledge-to-practice, and none described practice-to-data feedback with post-deployment outcomes informing model updating. AI applications capture only part of the LHS vision, concentrating on knowledge generation with less attention to the organizational and feedback mechanisms needed to translate insights into practice and sustain learning.
zh_abstract: 学习型健康系统（Learning Health Systems，LHSs）利用常规收集的数据，通过持续的学习循环生成证据，为实践提供依据。人工智能（AI）和数据科学可能强化这一模式，但 LHS 框架与 AI 应用之间的关系仍不明确。我们梳理了 LHS 框架及其组成部分，并考察了 AI 和数据科学是如何被整合的。检索纳入 2007 年 1 月至 2025 年 8 月发表的、以美国为背景的英文研究；两名评审员独立筛选并提取数据，分歧通过共识解决。我们纳入了 54 项框架研究（24 项 [44%] 为概念性改编；30 项 [56%] 为真实世界实施）和 30 项 AI/数据科学研究。各框架中反复出现五个组成部分：数据基础设施与互操作性、治理与利益相关者参与、学习与改进循环、证据生成与转化，以及公平与伦理。与框架研究相比，AI 研究较少涉及治理与利益相关者参与（17% 对 35%）或公平性（13% 对 22%），更强调计算功能而非组织功能。大多数 AI 研究（27/30）聚焦于数据到知识阶段；仅三项延伸至知识到实践阶段，且没有研究描述实践到数据的反馈，即利用部署后的结局来更新模型。AI 应用仅体现了 LHS 愿景的一部分，集中于知识生成，而对将洞见转化为实践并维持学习所需的组织机制和反馈机制关注较少。

title: MRI-derived synthetic [¹⁸F]FET PET in neuro-oncology: evaluation in glioma grading and differentiation from solitary brain metastasis.
zh_title: MRI生成合成[18F]FET PET：胶质瘤分级与脑转移鉴别评估
summary: 回顾性分析489例胶质瘤或脑转移患者，用深度学习从多模态MRI生成合成FET PET，并评估图像相似度、SUVR及读片者对分级与鉴别的表现。

以PSNR、SSIM、SUVR相关性评估合成质量
盲法读片评估胶质瘤分级及高级别胶质瘤与单发转移鉴别
reason: 回顾性、样本数百例，有读片者评估，无明确外部验证
abstract: [Neuroradiology] O-(2-[18F]fluoroethyl)-L-tyrosine positron emission tomography ([18F]FET PET) is clinically useful in neuro-oncology but limited by cost and availability. We assessed the clinical utility of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-derived synthetic [18F]FET PET. A total of 489 patients with histologically confirmed gliomas or brain metastases were retrospectively analyzed. A deep learning model generated synthetic PET images from multimodal MRI in the overall cohort and subgroups. Synthetic PET was evaluated against reference PET for image similarity by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) analysis by Pearson correlation and Bland-Altman analysis, and blinded reader assessment for glioma grading and high-grade glioma (HGG) versus solitary brain metastasis (SBM) differentiation using receiver operating characteristic analysis with area under the curve (AUC). Synthetic PET showed high similarity to reference PET in the overall, glioma, and metastasis groups (PSNR, 34.7-35.5 dB; SSIM, 0.90-0.96), and SUVR correlations were strong (r = 0.77-0.93, all P 0.05). MRI-derived synthetic [18F]FET PET may enhance glioma grading and HGG-SBM differentiation, providing a PET-like alternative when FET PET is unavailable.
zh_abstract: [神经放射学] O-(2-[18F]氟乙基)-L-酪氨酸正电子发射断层成像（[18F]FET PET）在神经肿瘤学中具有临床应用价值，但受限于成本和可及性。我们评估了源自磁共振成像（MRI）的合成 [18F]FET PET 的临床实用性。共对 489 例经组织学证实的胶质瘤或脑转移瘤患者进行了回顾性分析。深度学习模型基于多模态 MRI，在整体队列及各亚组中生成合成 PET 图像。将合成 PET 与参考 PET 进行比较评估：采用峰值信噪比（PSNR）和结构相似性指数（SSIM）评价图像相似性；采用 Pearson 相关和 Bland-Altman 分析评价标准化摄取值比（SUVR）；并由盲法阅片者对胶质瘤分级及高级别胶质瘤（HGG）与孤立性脑转移瘤（SBM）的鉴别进行评估，采用受试者工作特征分析及曲线下面积（AUC）。在整体、胶质瘤和转移瘤组中，合成 PET 与参考 PET 均显示出高度相似性（PSNR，34.7-35.5 dB；SSIM，0.90-0.96），SUVR 相关性较强（r = 0.77-0.93，所有 P 0.05）。源自 MRI 的合成 [18F]FET PET 可能有助于提升胶质瘤分级及 HGG 与 SBM 的鉴别能力，在无法获得 FET PET 时可提供类似 PET 的替代方案。

title: A personalized glucose-aware meal guidance agent for type 2 diabetes self-management.
source: PubMed · International journal of medical informatics
zh_title: 面向2型糖尿病自我管理的个性化血糖感知膳食指导智能体
summary: PiGMA将个体化餐后血糖预测转化为解释与膳食指导，回顾性概念验证，使用两中心140例患者的3857条餐食记录。

将PPGR预测转为预测关联的解释与指导

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Type 2 diabetes self-management requires individuals to coordinate meals, glucose monitoring, medications, insulin use, and daily routines outside the clinic. Although personalized postprandial glucose response (PPGR) prediction has advanced, numerical predictions alone do not provide the explanations and practical meal-level guidance needed for everyday decision-making. We developed a Personalized Glucose-aware Meal guidance Agent (PiGMA), to translate individualized PPGR predictions into prediction-linked explanations and meal-level guidance. This retrospective proof-of-concept study used 3857 meal records from 140 individuals with type 2 diabetes across two clinical centers, comprising a development cohort of 130 participants with 3580 meals and a held-out cohort of 10 participants with 277 meals. PiGMA combined a personalized PPGR predictor with an instruction-tuned LLaMA3.1-based guidance module trained for meal scoring, dietary advising, and PPGR interpretation. Evaluation included task-specific quantitative benchmarks, five-run G-Eval assessment, and blinded review by two endocrinologists. Participant-specific fine-tuning reduced mean absolute error in seven of ten held-out participants, with significant improvement using five or more days of personalization data. PiGMA outperformed the base model in meal scoring, achieved higher scores for PPGR interpretation, and outperformed medical-domain language models in dietary advising. In blinded expert evaluation, PiGMA received higher PPGR-interpretation ratings and was preferred in 33 of 40 endocrinologist rater-case judgments. However, character-span-level unsupported content was higher for PiGMA than for the base model in PPGR interpretation (12.29 % vs. 3.60 %). PiGMA provides retrospective proof-of-concept evidence that individualized PPGR predictions can be translated into prediction-linked meal guidance. However, the higher hallucination or unsupported-content rate and absence of prospective patient evaluation indicate a safety-reliability trade-off and preclude conclusions regarding clinical effectiveness, safety, or deployment readiness.

abstract: [Advanced drug delivery reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is advancing nanomedicine development by linking formulation variables and biological context with delivery, therapeutic efficacy, and safety. This review examines AI assisted formulation design, centralized formulation databases, prediction of nanoparticle self assembly, and models of cell and tissue selective delivery, biodistribution, and therapeutic outcomes. Recent advances in predicting nanotoxicity and nanoparticle induced immune responses further emphasize the importance of incorporating safety endpoints into nanomedicine optimization. Beyond nanocarrier engineering, foundation models and multimodal analyses of single-cell and spatial data are expanding biological discovery by characterizing disease associated cellular states, prioritizing therapeutic targets, and predicting treatment responses. Computational approaches also support the design of therapeutic RNA, peptides, proteins, and programmable protein nanomaterials. For example, mRNA sequences generated by GEMORNA and delivered via lipid nanoparticles increased erythropoietin expression in mice by up to 15-fold compared with a benchmark sequence. Integration of biological discovery with biomolecular and nanocarrier design may inform therapeutic cargo selection, targeting strategies, and functional nanomaterial development. AI may connect patient specific biological characteristics with predictions of nanomedicine delivery and therapeutic response to support patient stratification and individualized treatment selection. Integration of histological, imaging, molecular, and longitudinal data may enable treatment strategies to be adapted to differences in tissue characteristics, disease state, and therapeutic response. Emerging approaches based on digital twins and adaptive treatment control may extend the framework toward individualized dosing and dynamic treatment optimization. Major challenges include data heterogeneity, limited model generalizability, and the need for experimental and prospective validation. Progress toward precision therapy will require integrated frameworks that jointly consider delivery, efficacy, selectivity, and safety while clearly distinguishing demonstrated applications from future opportunities.

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] This viewpoint addresses developers and evaluators of large language model (LLM)-based clinical decision support systems. Although recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate multiple clinical reasoning domains, many still rely substantially on reference decision agreement-whether model outputs conform to predefined decisions. Our aim is to clarify when such agreement remains useful, when it becomes insufficient for complex or preference-sensitive decisions, and how it can be complemented by reasoning-centered assessment. Clinical decision-making often depends on structured reasoning under uncertainty, integrating probabilistic evidence, contextual constraints, and patient values. Using oncology as an illustrative domain, we argue that some decision variability is a structural feature of clinical reasoning rather than noise or error. Used alone in such settings, single-reference benchmarks may conflate reasonable divergence with incorrectness and reward answer imitation over transparent reasoning. We conclude that reference decision agreement should be retained for tasks with stable ground truth but supplemented by evidence grounding, reasoning quality, patient-centeredness, and safety checks for open-ended clinical decision support. This multidimensional approach is intended to support safer and more clinically meaningful evaluation.

abstract: [Cancers] The diagnosis of colorectal cancer encompasses nine complementary modalities: stool-based screening, blood-based biomarkers, cross-sectional imaging, endoscopic evaluation, histopathology, liquid biopsy, molecular and genetic profiling, microbiome analysis, and nanotechnology-based diagnostics. This narrative review synthesizes 160 references spanning seven task-specific artificial intelligence domains, including computer-aided detection, optical diagnosis, invasion depth prediction, computational pathology and radiogenomics, metastasis forecasting, neoadjuvant treatment response prediction, and surgical workflow analysis. We propose a conceptual multimodal pipeline comprising data ingestion, preprocessing and harmonization, feature representation, multimodal fusion, forecasting, explainability, and validation. A structured evidence grading framework classifies each clinical task by evidence level, consistency, and clinical readiness. We further catalog public datasets, challenge benchmarks, and five reporting standards: TRIPOD-AI, CONSORT-AI, SPIRIT-AI, DECIDE-AI, and CLAIM. Computer-aided detection and optical diagnosis demonstrate the highest maturity with Level 1 evidence from randomized controlled trials, while computational pathology, radiogenomics, and metastasis prediction remain at Level 2 with retrospective validation (internal or external). Microbiome screening, nanotechnology diagnostics, and surgical phase recognition are exploratory. The principal barriers to clinical adoption are domain shift, data scarcity, calibration, prospective validation, and workflow integration. We conclude that clinically useful artificial intelligence requires robust external validation, uncertainty quantification, explainable outputs, standardized reporting, and a structured translational pathway from retrospective evidence through regulatory clearance to post-deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: [Cancers] 结直肠癌的诊断涵盖九种互补的方式：基于粪便的筛查、基于血液的生物标志物、断层影像、内镜评估、组织病理学、液体活检、分子与基因谱分析、微生物组分析以及基于纳米技术的诊断。本叙述性综述综合了 160 篇参考文献，涉及七个针对特定任务的人工智能领域，包括计算机辅助检测、光学诊断、浸润深度预测、计算病理学与影像基因组学（radiogenomics）、转移预测、新辅助治疗反应预测以及手术流程分析。我们提出了一个概念性的多模态流程，包括数据摄取、预处理与标准化、特征表示、多模态融合、预测、可解释性和验证。一个结构化的证据分级框架按证据水平、一致性和临床就绪程度对每项临床任务进行分类。我们还整理了公共数据集、挑战赛基准以及五项报告规范：TRIPOD-AI、CONSORT-AI、SPIRIT-AI、DECIDE-AI 和 CLAIM。计算机辅助检测和光学诊断成熟度最高，具有来自随机对照试验的 1 级证据；而计算病理学、影像基因组学和转移预测仍处于 2 级，仅有回顾性验证（内部或外部）。微生物组筛查、纳米技术诊断和手术阶段识别尚属探索性。临床应用的主要障碍是领域偏移、数据稀缺、校准、前瞻性验证以及工作流程整合。我们认为，具有临床实用价值的人工智能需要可靠的外部验证、不确定性量化、可解释的输出、标准化报告，以及从回顾性证据、监管审批到部署后监测的结构化转化路径。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Reliable classification of skin lesions is essential for early melanoma detection; however, substantial visual overlap among lesion types and pronounced class imbalance continue to limit the performance and reliability of existing automated systems. These challenges motivate the integration of complementary visual representations with clinical metadata to improve discrimination across lesion classes. Methods: This study introduces a calibrated multimodal ensemble learning framework for skin lesion classification. The proposed framework combines visual features extracted from Swin Transformer, EVA-02, and CoAtNet architectures with patient age and anatomical region information. A two-stage adaptive temperature scaling is applied to calibrate the predicted probabilities of the ensemble. Results: Experimental evaluation on the International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC 2019) dataset demonstrates strong classification performance, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.91 and a macro-AUC of 0.99. The framework further showed robust generalization on the official ISIC 2019 benchmark set, attaining a balanced accuracy of 0.65. The external validation on the PH2 dataset yielded a macro-F1 score of 0.93 and an ROC-AUC of 0.96. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate that combining heterogeneous visual representations, clinical metadata, and calibration-aware ensemble learning provides a robust and trustworthy solution for skin lesion classification and computer-aided dermatological diagnosis.

abstract: [European journal of neurology] Hereditary neuromuscular disorders exhibit marked phenotypic and molecular heterogeneity, which weakens genotype-phenotype correlation and complicates timely diagnosis, prognosis, and patient stratification for clinical trials. The Horizon Europe project CoMPaSS-NMD aims to develop artificial-intelligence-based stratification tools by integrating clinical, genetic, histopathological, and imaging data from clinical reference centers across Europe and the United Kingdom. We developed CoMPaSS-NMD Atlas, a secure, modular web platform for pseudonymized data collection, multimodal data management, and controlled exploration. Clinical, technical, and data-management experts defined requirements; contributing centers co-designed electronic clinical and histopathology forms. Clinical phenotypes used the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO), while imaging, histopathology, and sequencing data followed international standards. The platform supports role- and attribute-based access, pseudonymized patient registration, metadata management, structured clinical data entry, MRI and histopathological uploads, and a dedicated genetic-sequencing workflow. Cohort-level exploration is driven by structured metadata and HPO terms, enabling hierarchical phenotype navigation, ontology-aware data navigation, and cross-domain queries spanning clinical, genetic, imaging, and histopathological features. Users can download raw files in their original formats, along with structured metadata reports in CSV or PDF, according to the permissions defined for data protection. The Atlas provides a foundation for harmonized, standardized prospective data collection and for building large datasets for artificial intelligence- and machine learning-based patient stratification. With secure governance, traceability, and multimodal integration, it is designed to support diagnostic and stratification research in hereditary neuromuscular disorders; clinical validation is ongoing.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Cardiovascular diseases continue to be the primary cause of mortality worldwide; however, precise diagnosis is often limited by dependence on individual data modalities and the unclear nature of traditional deep learning models. In this study, we introduce an explainable multimodal deep learning framework that simultaneously analyzes cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and structured clinical variables through a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism that operates on token sequences. The architecture utilizes modality-specific encoders ResNet-50 for imaging and a multilayer perceptron for clinical data interconnected through attention that dynamically aligns complementary information, reducing feature dilution and modal dominance. A multitask objective that includes classification, contrastive alignment (InfoNCE), and regularization further reinforces semantic consistency across modalities. Integrated post hoc explainability modules, such as Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping for spatial localization and SHapley Additive exPlanations for clinical feature attribution, offer transparent decision support. Tested on a cohort of 12,847 patients using fivefold cross-validation, the framework achieved an accuracy of 94.2% and an area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve of 0.97, significantly surpassing unimodal and traditional multimodal baselines (p < 0.01). The explanations generated showed 91% concordance with independent cardiologist evaluations. The findings presented herein were derived through internal five-fold cross-validation conducted at a solitary tertiary care institution, thereby substantiating internal validity while limiting multicenter generalizability; consequently, external validation is requisite for broader applicability. These results demonstrate that attention-driven multimodal fusion, combined with post hoc explainability, provides both strong diagnostic performance and clinically useful transparency, positioning the framework as a promising internally validated approach and a foundation for future external validation.
zh_abstract: 心血管疾病仍是全球主要死因；然而，精确诊断常受限于对单一数据模态的依赖以及传统深度学习模型的不透明性。本研究提出了一种可解释的多模态深度学习框架，通过作用于token序列的双向跨模态注意力机制，同时分析心脏磁共振成像（MRI）和结构化临床变量。该架构采用针对各模态的编码器——影像使用ResNet-50，临床数据使用多层感知机——并通过注意力相互连接，动态对齐互补信息，从而减少特征稀释和模态主导。包含分类、对比对齐（InfoNCE）和正则化的多任务目标进一步增强了各模态间的语义一致性。集成的事后可解释性模块，如用于空间定位的梯度加权类激活映射（Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping）和用于临床特征归因的SHapley加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations），提供了透明的决策支持。在12,847例患者的队列中采用五折交叉验证进行测试，该框架的准确率为94.2%，受试者操作特征曲线下面积为0.97，显著优于单模态及传统多模态基线（p < 0.01）。所生成的解释与独立心脏病专家评估的一致率为91%。本文结果来自在单一三级医疗机构进行的内部五折交叉验证，从而证实了内部有效性，但限制了多中心的普适性；因此，要扩大适用范围，需要进行外部验证。这些结果表明，注意力驱动的多模态融合结合事后可解释性，既提供了强大的诊断性能，也提供了对临床有用的透明度，使该框架成为一种有前景的、经内部验证的方法，并为今后的外部验证奠定基础。

abstract: [Brazilian oral research] To develop a labeled image dataset of suspected carotid artery calcifications (CACs) on dental panoramic radiographs (PRs) and to propose a deep learning-based framework for their automated detection and segmentation. A retrospective dataset comprising 19,205 PRs obtained from our institution (between 2015 and 2023) was analyzed. After manual labeling, 372 images showing CACs and 322 controls were included. A hybrid architecture combining FasTVit, AttentionNet, and DC-UNet was implemented for classification, detection, and segmentation. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, the Dice coefficient, intersection over union (IoU), and area under the curve (AUC). The study evaluated two scenarios: one in which detection and segmentation were performed after classification, and another in which the classification was omitted. The classification model achieved an accuracy of 0.8780, a precision of 0.8779, a recall of 0.8795, and a specificity of, 0.8795. Incorporating the classification step improved precision from 0.48 to 0.93, accuracy from 0.79 to 0.97, and specificity from 0.75 to 0.98. The final framework achieved an area under the ROC curve of 0.96. The proposed hybrid artificial intelligence (AI) framework showed promising internal performance for the opportunistic detection and localization of radiographic findings suggestive of CACs on PRs. Within the limitations of this study, the proposed framework may serve as a complementary aid to dentists by flagging suspected CACs during routine interpretation of PRs and facilitating timely referral for confirmatory cardiovascular assessment.

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive cardiopulmonary disorder associated with high morbidity and mortality. Delayed diagnosis, heterogeneous disease phenotypes, and variable treatment responses remain major clinical challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising tool for improving PH management. AI-based models have demonstrated promising performance in screening, diagnosis, classification, risk stratification, and prognosis prediction using multimodal data such as electrocardiography, chest radiography, computed tomography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, echocardiography, and electronic health records. Furthermore, AI may support individualized risk assessment, treatment-response prediction, early identification of right ventricular deterioration, and longitudinal remote monitoring. Emerging technologies, including explainable AI, federated learning, large language models, and digital twins, may further advance precision medicine in PH. Despite these advances, data quality, interpretability, privacy, and clinical implementation of AI remain challenges. This review summarizes current applications, opportunities, and challenges of AI in PH and discusses future directions for AI-assisted precision healthcare.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to improve diagnostic accuracy, reproducibility, and efficiency in anatomical pathology, but technical success alone does not establish clinical utility. In this Perspective, we examine practical requirements for translating computational pathology tools into routine practice, including prioritization of genuine clinical bottlenecks, representative datasets, independent validation, workflow integration, costs, clinician oversight, regulatory compliance, and post-deployment monitoring. We distinguish evidence from retrospective model evaluations, controlled reader studies, prospective workflow assessments, and economic simulations, recognizing that their conclusions are not interchangeable. We also propose a staged, decision-oriented framework through which laboratories can assess clinical need, select technologies, perform local validation, conduct prospective pilots, deploy with safeguards, and monitor performance throughout the AI lifecycle. Evidence from selected applications is encouraging, but effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, and readiness for routine use vary by intended purpose and practice environment. Responsible adoption should therefore be guided by demonstrated clinical benefit, operational feasibility, and ongoing evaluation rather than algorithmic performance alone.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）有潜力提高解剖病理学的诊断准确性、可重复性和效率，但仅有技术上的成功并不能确立临床效用。在本观点文章中，我们探讨了将计算病理学工具转化为常规实践的实际要求，包括优先解决真正的临床瓶颈、具有代表性的数据集、独立验证、工作流程整合、成本、临床医生监督、法规合规以及部署后监测。我们区分了来自回顾性模型评估、对照读片者研究、前瞻性工作流程评估和经济学模拟的证据，并认识到它们的结论不可互换。我们还提出了一个分阶段、以决策为导向的框架，实验室可据此评估临床需求、选择技术、进行本地验证、开展前瞻性试点、在保障措施下部署，并在整个 AI 生命周期内监测性能。部分应用的证据令人鼓舞，但有效性、成本效益和常规使用的准备程度因预期用途和实践环境而异。因此，负责任的采用应以已证实的临床获益、操作可行性和持续评估为指导，而不应仅依据算法性能。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Multimodal artificial intelligence may support point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) interpretation in emergency medicine, but its performance on static images and sensitivity to acquisition context remain uncertain. This study evaluated GPT-5.6 Sol and assessed whether probe-region information improves interpretation across view/plane, anatomy, and pathology domains. Methods: In this paired comparative in silico study, 92 educational ultrasound images from seven anatomical regions were assessed under standardized uninformed (image only) and informed (image plus probe-region code) prompting conditions. Two independent raters scored responses against textbook-based references in three domains: view/plane identification, anatomical structure identification, and pathological finding detection. Each domain was scored from 0 to 2. Disagreements were resolved by a third ultrasound expert, and fully correct responses were defined as domain scores of 2. The primary outcome was the total performance score (0-6). Secondary outcomes included domain-specific scores, fully correct response rates, and exploratory subgroup analyses. Wilcoxon signed-rank and McNemar tests assessed paired scores and fully correct rates, respectively. Results: Total performance was higher with informed prompting (median (interquartile range), 5 (4-6) versus 4 (2-5); p < 0.001). Interrater agreement was substantial to almost perfect across evaluation domains (quadratic-weighted κ = 0.750-1.000). Fully correct rates increased from 58.7% to 88.0% for view/plane identification and from 47.8% to 82.6% for anatomical structure identification (both p < 0.001). Pathological finding detection improved from 35.9% to 48.9% (p = 0.002). Among pathology-positive images, missed or incorrectly labeled pathology remained frequent (44.8%) despite informed prompting. Regional differences in total performance were significant only under uninformed prompting (p = 0.002). Conclusions: Probe-region information substantially improved view/plane and anatomical structure identification, but pathological finding detection remained comparatively weak. In static POCUS interpretation, improved anatomical recognition did not translate into reliable pathology detection. Persistent false-negative and false-positive errors do not support independent diagnostic use. Potential applications in POCUS education and anatomical labeling require further validation.
zh_abstract:
【背景/目的】多模态人工智能可能有助于急诊医学中的床旁超声（POCUS）判读，但其在静态图像上的表现以及对采集情境的敏感性仍不明确。本研究评估了 GPT-5.6 Sol，并考察探头区域信息是否能改善其在切面/平面、解剖结构和病理领域的判读。
【方法】在这项配对比较的计算机模拟研究中，对来自七个解剖区域的 92 幅教学超声图像，在标准化的无信息（仅图像）和有信息（图像加探头区域代码）两种提示条件下进行评估。两名独立评分者依据教科书参考标准，在三个领域对回答进行评分：切面/平面识别、解剖结构识别和病理发现检测。每个领域评分为 0 至 2 分。分歧由第三位超声专家解决，领域得分为 2 分即定义为完全正确。主要结局为总表现得分（0-6 分）。次要结局包括各领域得分、完全正确率及探索性亚组分析。分别采用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验和 McNemar 检验评估配对得分和完全正确率。
【结果】有信息提示下总表现更高（中位数（四分位距），5（4-6）对 4（2-5）；p < 0.001）。各评估领域的评分者间一致性为较高至几乎完全一致（二次加权 κ = 0.750-1.000）。切面/平面识别的完全正确率由 58.7% 升至 88.0%，解剖结构识别由 47.8% 升至 82.6%（均 p < 0.001）。病理发现检测由 35.9% 提高至 48.9%（p = 0.002）。在病理阳性图像中，即使给予有信息提示，漏诊或错误标注病理的情况仍然常见（44.8%）。总表现的区域差异仅在无信息提示下具有显著性（p = 0.002）。
【结论】探头区域信息显著改善了切面/平面和解剖结构识别，但病理发现检测仍相对较弱。在静态 POCUS 判读中，解剖识别的改善并未转化为可靠的病理检测。持续存在的假阴性和假阳性错误不支持其独立用于诊断。其在 POCUS 教学和解剖标注方面的潜在应用尚需进一步验证。

abstract: [Australian dental journal] A proportion of Australians encounter substantial unmet oral health needs despite eligibility for government-subsidised care. Yet, government dental services operate within a fragmented, mixed public-private system with limited capacity to support priority populations. The National Oral Health Plan (2015-2024) responds to this visible and measured need for priority. As the next National Oral Health Plan is developed, these priorities provide a timely basis to consider whether emerging technologies can support access and system performance without reproducing existing inequities. This narrative review aims to examine the potential uses, evidence for, challenges and implementation considerations of the use of Artificial Intelligence including machine learning, in Australian public-funded dental services, and to examine the implications for access, equity, governance, community co-design and workforce capability. The evidence is interpreted through a multidimensional framework for access to care, while retaining the National Oral Health Plan (2015-2024) as the policy context. Limited research conducted in Australian-based healthcare settings shows evidence for public dental system-level improvements for triage, risk stratification, service planning and workflow, but also identifies material concerns about opportunity cost, human oversight, non-representative data, algorithmic bias, cultural safety, Indigenous Data Sovereignty and clinician education. Artificial Intelligence and machine learning technologies may support more responsive public-funded dental services, but technical performance alone is not evidence of improved access or equitable care. Intentional, values-led implementation requires representative data, Indigenous-led governance, community co-design, transparent evaluation, human accountability and a digitally capable workforce.
zh_abstract: [Australian dental journal] 尽管符合政府补贴医疗服务的资格，仍有一部分澳大利亚人面临大量未满足的口腔健康需求。然而，政府牙科服务运行于碎片化的公私混合体系之中，支持重点人群的能力有限。《国家口腔健康计划（2015–2024）》正是对这一可见且已被衡量的优先需求的回应。随着下一期国家口腔健康计划的制定，这些优先事项为思考新兴技术能否在不复制既有不平等的前提下支持服务可及性和体系绩效提供了适时的依据。本叙述性综述旨在探讨人工智能（包括机器学习）在澳大利亚公共资助牙科服务中的潜在用途、证据、挑战和实施考量，并探讨其对可及性、公平性、治理、社区共同设计和劳动力能力的影响。证据的解读采用多维度的医疗可及性框架，同时以《国家口腔健康计划（2015–2024）》作为政策背景。在澳大利亚医疗环境中开展的研究有限，这些研究显示出在分诊、风险分层、服务规划和工作流程方面改善公共牙科体系层面的证据，但也指出了在机会成本、人工监督、数据缺乏代表性、算法偏倚、文化安全、原住民数据主权和临床医生教育方面的实质性担忧。人工智能和机器学习技术可能有助于使公共资助的牙科服务更具响应性，但仅有技术性能并不能证明可及性得到改善或医疗服务更加公平。有意识的、以价值观为导向的实施需要具有代表性的数据、由原住民主导的治理、社区共同设计、透明的评估、人类问责以及具备数字能力的劳动力。

abstract: [Journal of critical care] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in critical care practice at a time when pharmacotherapeutic decisions are becoming more complex, data-intensive, and time-sensitive. For medical residents and fellows, this creates both educational opportunities and challenges, as AI may support learning but must not replace the development of independent clinical judgment. This perspective examines potential applications of AI in ICU pharmacotherapy training, including support for just-in-time learning, case-based practice, and bedside decision support. Key limitations and risks, such as misinformation, cognitive offloading, deskilling, privacy and data security, and bias in model outputs, are discussed along with possible mitigation strategies. Future training should prioritize building competencies related to AI-assisted clinical decision-making, including critical appraisal of AI-generated outputs and communication of AI-informed decisions within interprofessional teams. AI-supported pharmacotherapy training should be guided by clear boundaries around use and continued emphasis on building foundational pharmacotherapy knowledge, patient-specific reasoning, and clinical judgment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of critical care] 在药物治疗决策日益复杂、数据密集且时间紧迫之际，人工智能（AI）越来越多地融入重症医学实践。对于住院医师和专科培训医师而言，这既带来教育机遇，也带来挑战：AI 可能有助于学习，但不得取代独立临床判断能力的培养。本文观点探讨了 AI 在 ICU 药物治疗培训中的潜在应用，包括对即时学习、基于病例的练习和床旁决策支持的辅助。文中讨论了主要的局限性和风险，如错误信息、认知卸载、技能退化、隐私与数据安全以及模型输出中的偏倚，并讨论了可能的缓解策略。未来的培训应优先培养与 AI 辅助临床决策相关的能力，包括对 AI 生成结果的批判性评价，以及在跨专业团队中沟通由 AI 提供信息的决策。AI 辅助的药物治疗培训应在明确使用边界的指导下进行，并持续强调打好药物治疗基础知识、针对患者的推理和临床判断能力。

title: Toward Clinically Trustworthy Deep Learning in Cardiology: A Unified Mathematical Synthesis of Representation, Optimization, and Reliability.
zh_title: 心脏病学可信深度学习：表示、优化与可靠性的数学综述
summary: 依据PRISMA对2017–2025年79篇文献做系统综述，从统一数学视角讨论心脏病学深度学习的可信性，指出预测准确率与临床可靠性之间存在差距。
key_points: 纳入79篇2017–2025年同行评审文献
涵盖不确定性、鲁棒性、公平性、可解释性与泛化

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Deep learning (DL) has revolutionized cardiovascular medicine by allowing for automated analysis of electrocardiography, imaging of the heart, and multimodal clinical datasets. Although there have been impressive advancements in terms of predictive performance, the deployment of DL methods in a clinical setting remains limited due to lack of sufficient mathematical understanding around the concepts of uncertainty, robustness, fairness, explainability, and generalizability. Methods: In this work, a systematic review is conducted using PRISMA principles on 79 peer-reviewed articles published from 2017 until 2025, with a unifying mathematical perspective on the notion of trustworthy deep learning in cardiology. Results: We find that there is significant discrepancy between prediction accuracy and clinical reliability, with little emphasis placed on mathematical guarantees, reproducibility of evaluation procedures, calibration, or robustness verification. To address this challenge, we propose a conceptual mathematical framework which brings together the elements of representation learning, optimization, and trustworthiness into a unified audit of AI in cardiac care. We note that the presented indices are purely theoretical and are meant to provide guidance for future standardization, and as such do not represent actual clinical metrics. Conclusions: Although our paper does not propose any new predictive algorithms, we do contribute a strong theoretical basis for the evaluation and development of clinically reliable deep learning algorithms in cardiology.
zh_abstract:
【背景】深度学习（DL）通过实现心电图、心脏影像及多模态临床数据集的自动化分析，革新了心血管医学。尽管在预测性能方面取得了令人瞩目的进展，但由于对不确定性、稳健性、公平性、可解释性和可泛化性等概念缺乏足够的数学理解，DL 方法在临床环境中的应用仍然有限。
【方法】本研究遵循 PRISMA 原则，对 2017 年至 2025 年发表的 79 篇同行评审文章进行了系统综述，并从统一的数学视角探讨心脏病学中可信深度学习的概念。
【结果】我们发现预测准确性与临床可靠性之间存在显著差异，对数学保证、评估流程的可重复性、校准或稳健性验证的关注很少。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个概念性数学框架，将表征学习、优化和可信性等要素整合为对心脏护理中人工智能的统一审查。我们指出，所提出的指标纯属理论性质，旨在为未来的标准化提供指导，因此并不代表实际的临床指标。
【结论】尽管本文并未提出任何新的预测算法，但我们为评估和开发心脏病学中临床可靠的深度学习算法提供了坚实的理论基础。

abstract: [Psychiatry research. Neuroimaging] Alzheimer's disease is the most prevalent neurodegenerative disease, resulting in progressive memory loss in people. It has a significant impact on the population and the global healthcare system. Disease acquisition is a major concern due to the absence of pre-existing treatment options. The growth of machine learning and deep learning-based algorithms is effective in analyzing EEG data for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease. This systematic literature review investigates existing primary studies that focus on applying ML and DL in the identification of Alzheimer's disease, with emphasis on pre-processing, feature extraction, and classification. In doing so, it assesses the results produced by varying algorithms and addresses the problems encountered while deploying these systems. The review's objective is to offer a current situation and potential solutions for practitioners and scholars interested in healthcare service issues.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病是最常见的神经退行性疾病，可导致人的进行性记忆丧失。它对人群和全球医疗体系具有重大影响。由于缺乏既有的治疗选择，疾病的发生是一个主要关注点。基于机器学习和深度学习的算法的发展在分析脑电图（EEG）数据以诊断阿尔茨海默病方面是有效的。本系统文献综述调查了现有关于将机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）应用于阿尔茨海默病识别的原始研究，重点关注预处理、特征提取和分类。在此过程中，评估了不同算法所得的结果，并探讨了部署这些系统时遇到的问题。本综述的目的是为关注医疗服务问题的从业者和学者提供当前状况及潜在的解决方案。

title: Generative AI, Health Misinformation, and Medical Deepfakes: Implications for Diagnostic Safety and Clinical Practice-A Narrative Review.

summary: 叙述性综述生成式AI如何通过文本、图像、语音和视频制造可信的健康虚假信息，并讨论对诊断安全与临床实践的影响。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) can rapidly produce persuasive health information in the form of text, synthetic images, cloned voices and deepfake videos. It can also be used to create fictitious professional identities. This narrative review describes how synthetic claims, fabricated evidence and simulated identities are used to disguise misleading health information and give it the appearance of authenticity especially with regard to diagnostic safety and clinical practice. Literature identified through Web of Science and Scopus was synthesized across text image audio video and multimodal formats; current evidence indicates that generative AI can produce highly credible but inaccurate health content. Source authority, message framing and professional identity cues influence trust and verification behavior, while disease-specific evaluations show that high average accuracy may coexist with clinically important omissions, missed referrals, hallucinated findings and poor calibration. In medical imaging, errors may arise both from incorrect interpretation and from manipulation of the diagnostic evidence itself. Detection, evidence-based verification, provenance, literacy interventions, and governance provide complementary safeguards, although real-world and longitudinal evidence remains limited. Clinical evaluation should therefore consider task-specific performance, source authenticity, human oversight, and the consequences of individual errors alongside overall accuracy.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 生成式人工智能（AI）可以快速生成具有说服力的健康信息，形式包括文本、合成图像、克隆语音和深度伪造视频，还可用于创建虚构的专业身份。本叙述性综述描述了合成性主张、伪造的证据和模拟的身份如何被用来掩饰具有误导性的健康信息并使其看似真实，尤其涉及诊断安全和临床实践。我们综合了通过 Web of Science 和 Scopus 检索到的涉及文本、图像、音频、视频及多模态形式的文献；目前的证据表明，生成式 AI 可以产生高度可信但不准确的健康内容。信息来源的权威性、信息框架和专业身份线索会影响信任和核查行为，而针对特定疾病的评估显示，较高的平均准确率可能与具有临床意义的遗漏、漏诊转诊、幻觉性发现以及较差的校准并存。在医学影像中，错误既可能源于解读不正确，也可能源于对诊断证据本身的篡改。检测、循证核查、溯源、素养干预和治理提供了互补的保障措施，但真实世界和纵向的证据仍然有限。因此，临床评估除总体准确率外，还应考虑任务特异性表现、来源真实性、人工监督以及个别错误的后果。

abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Ageing is a multidimensional biological process characterised by interacting molecular, physiological, functional, and environmental changes that chronological age alone cannot adequately represent. The rapid development of epigenetic clocks, proteomic and metabolomic signatures, imaging-derived biomarkers, wearable sensors, and digital phenotypes has created an increasingly rich but fragmented landscape of aging biomarkers. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a potential integrative framework that can combine these heterogeneous data streams and convert them into multidimensional estimates of biological age, health risk, functional reserve, and potentially treatment response. Recent studies demonstrate that molecular and clinical information can be integrated into composite aging measures, while independent work shows that wearable movement data, retinal imaging, and speech characteristics can provide non-invasive digital representations of aging-related phenotypes. The emerging concept of multimodal aging clocks extends these approaches by integrating physiological, clinical, imaging, and molecular measurements into a common representation of biological aging.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 衰老是一个多维度的生物学过程，其特征是分子、生理、功能和环境层面的变化相互作用，仅凭实足年龄无法充分反映。表观遗传时钟、蛋白质组学和代谢组学特征、影像衍生生物标志物、可穿戴传感器以及数字表型的快速发展，使衰老生物标志物的格局日益丰富，但也趋于碎片化。人工智能（AI）提供了一种潜在的整合框架，可以整合这些异质性数据流，并将其转化为对生物学年龄、健康风险、功能储备以及（潜在的）治疗反应的多维估计。近期研究表明，分子信息与临床信息可以整合为复合型衰老指标，而独立研究显示，可穿戴设备的运动数据、视网膜成像和语音特征可为衰老相关表型提供非侵入性的数字化表征。多模态衰老时钟这一新兴概念通过将生理、临床、影像和分子测量整合为生物衰老的统一表征，进一步拓展了上述方法。

title: A Symbolic Inference System for AI Decision Support in Multimodal Assessment of Pediatric Cerebral Visual Impairment.

abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] Cerebral visual impairment (CVI) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition in which visual dysfunction may affect acuity, visual field, ocular motility, fixation, electrophysiological responses, and functional vision. Multimodal assessment is therefore required, but the resulting evidence is often incomplete, heterogeneous, and difficult to integrate reproducibly. This computational feasibility study developed a symbolic AI decision-support model for multimodal assessment of pediatric CVI. Sixty-two children older than 18 months and younger than 18 years were encoded as patient-level facts after neuro-ophthalmological assessment and brain and orbital MRI. Structured variables included MRI status, refraction, ocular motility, visual field testing, and visual evoked potentials. An anterior-pathway-not-explanatory predicate was used as a non-weighted eligibility gate, while a priori expert-defined support weights were assigned to positive evidence domains. MRI abnormalities and ocular motility abnormalities were each present in 47/62 patients (75.8%), visual field alterations in 16/62 (25.8%), and altered visual evoked potentials in 22/62 (35.5%). At least one predefined CVI-compatible functional proof path was established in 54/62 patients (87.1%). With k=1, CVI support scores ranged from 0.700 to 0.800, reflecting the strongest retained functional path. With k=3, the maximum support score was 0.985 in patients with three retained functional paths. Equal-weight ablation (w=0.75 for each functional domain) preserved logical derivability and yielded a three-path value of 0.9844, indicating that multi-path convergence was not dependent on the small differences among the expert-assigned functional weights. No independent diagnostic gold standard was available; therefore, these findings characterize symbolic derivability and provenance behavior rather than diagnostic accuracy. The proposed system provides an explicit, provenance-aware decision-support representation and a foundation for future neurosymbolic integration of quantitative clinical and instrumental data.
zh_abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] 脑性视觉障碍（CVI）是一种异质性的神经发育性疾病，其视觉功能障碍可影响视力、视野、眼球运动、注视、电生理反应和功能性视觉。因此需要进行多模态评估，但所得证据往往不完整、异质性强，且难以以可重复的方式整合。这项计算可行性研究开发了一种用于小儿CVI多模态评估的符号式AI决策支持模型。62名年龄大于18个月且小于18岁的儿童，在完成神经眼科评估及脑部和眼眶MRI后，被编码为患者层面的事实。结构化变量包括MRI状态、屈光、眼球运动、视野检查和视觉诱发电位。“前路径不足以解释”谓词被用作不加权的纳入资格关卡，同时为阳性证据领域分配了预先由专家确定的支持权重。MRI异常和眼球运动异常均见于47/62例患者（75.8%），视野改变见于16/62例（25.8%），视觉诱发电位改变见于22/62例（35.5%）。54/62例患者（87.1%）至少建立了一条预先定义的与CVI相符的功能证明路径。当k=1时，CVI支持分数范围为0.700至0.800，反映保留下来的最强功能路径。当k=3时，保留三条功能路径的患者最大支持分数为0.985。等权重消融分析（每个功能领域w=0.75）保留了逻辑可推导性，三路径值为0.9844，表明多路径汇聚并不依赖于专家分配的功能权重之间的微小差异。由于没有独立的诊断金标准，这些结果刻画的是符号可推导性和溯源行为，而非诊断准确性。所提出的系统提供了一种明确的、具备溯源意识的决策支持表示，并为未来定量临床和仪器数据的神经符号整合奠定了基础。

title: Artificial Intelligence Approaches for Gastrointestinal Bleeding Detection in Capsule Endoscopy: A Systematic Review and Critical Analysis.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding is a common, potentially life-threatening condition, and capsule endoscopy (CE) is the principal investigation for suspected small-bowel bleeding after non-diagnostic upper endoscopy and colonoscopy. Because manual review of thousands of CE frames is labor-intensive, artificial intelligence (AI) has been proposed to automate bleeding detection. Methods: Following PRISMA 2020, this systematic review synthesizes 15 peer-reviewed journal studies (2020-2025) applying traditional machine learning, convolutional neural networks, transfer learning, attention-based or hybrid architectures, segmentation, or object detection to GI bleeding detection in CE. Methodological quality was appraised with an AI-adapted risk-of-bias framework informed by QUADAS-2 and PROBAST. Results: Frame-level classification accuracy ranged from 90.6% to 99.9% (median 98.5%; 13 studies), with the lowest values from evaluations closest to clinical practice; the segmentation and detection studies reported a mean intersection-over-union of 86.9% and an mAP@0.5 of 79.0%. Only two studies (13%) were at low risk of bias for validation strategy, none reported patient-level separation of training and test data, only four (27%) used clinical patient data, and none compared AI with conventional endoscopy or clinical outcomes. Conclusions: Current evidence demonstrates high performance on curated datasets but not yet generalizability or clinical readiness; patient-level, external, and prospective multicentre validation is required.

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Aim: To map recent artificial intelligence research in family medicine and primary care against an earlier 2015-2024 bibliometric baseline. Methods: Scopus was searched on 9 July 2026 for 2016-2026 publications. One researcher screened 3452 articles and reviews; 132 topical and 13 language exclusions left 3307 records. Manual title, DOI, and Scopus-identifier checks identified no duplicates. VOSviewer 1.6.21 and Biblioshiny (Bibliometrix 5.4.1; R 4.6.1) supported descriptive analysis and mapping. Results: Output increased from 531 in 2024 to 792 in 2025 (49.2%). The 2025 and partial 2026 component contained 1407 records (42.5%); 615 were dated 2026. The USA led publication and raw citation rankings (711 publications; 18,671 citations), while China preceded the United Kingdom in publication count. The Journal of Medical Internet Research (78 publications) and Scientific Reports (69) led the venues; seven top ten venues were shared with the earlier study. Language model terminology coexisted with later-positioned explainability, risk stratification, and diagnostic accuracy terms. Conclusions: This updated map quantifies post-2024 activity and identifies continuity and corpus-dependent differences in geography, dissemination, and evaluation-related vocabulary. Single-database and English language coverage, single-researcher screening, unadjusted citations, and incomplete 2026 coverage limit inference. The findings describe research activity, not clinical adoption, safety, effectiveness, or causality.

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Saudi Health consumers increasingly rely on generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) to access health information from a growing number of health-related resources. Little is known about the frequency and patterns of generative AI tool use for seeking health information among consumers, its reported impact, and health consumers' perceptions of these tools. This study aims to investigate the use of and perspectives on generative AI tools among health consumers in Saudi Arabia (SA). It also aims to assess the impact of their use on health-seeking behaviours. An exploratory, cross-sectional, self-administered online survey was distributed to adults (≥18 years) residing in SA during two data collection rounds in 2026 (March-April and July-August). All adults who used generative AI tools to seek online health information in the past year were included. Bivariate and multivariate analyses were conducted to examine relationships among variables. A total of 403 eligible health consumers (58% male) participated. Among respondents who had used generative AI for health purposes, approximately 49% reported using it more than five times per month. Younger age, higher income, and more frequent pre-use were associated with higher odds of frequent seeking health information behaviour. Headache, abdominal pain, and musculoskeletal pain were the most common claims. ChatGPT was the main platform (84%) used for seeking information. Age was significantly negatively associated with frequency, whereas income and pre-visit use were positively associated. The primary reasons for seeking health information via generative AI were quick information retrieval (71%), time saving (34%), and curiosity (30.5%). The high frequency of use suggests that generative AI can serve as a source of health information and may lead users to withhold health information from healthcare providers. It may influence subsequent health-seeking behaviours, such as requesting urgent care or postponing physician visits. These self-reported findings do not establish diagnostic accuracy, clinical effectiveness, or patient safety, and the clinical risk and appropriateness of self-management actions were not assessed. Many respondents reported concerns about inaccurate information, missed serious illness, and increased health anxiety.
zh_abstract: 沙特的健康消费者越来越依赖生成式人工智能（AI），从日益增多的健康相关资源中获取健康信息。目前对于消费者使用生成式AI工具查找健康信息的频率和模式、其报告的影响以及健康消费者对这些工具的看法所知甚少。本研究旨在调查沙特阿拉伯（SA）健康消费者对生成式AI工具的使用情况和看法，并评估其使用对健康求助行为的影响。在2026年的两轮数据收集（3–4月和7–8月）期间，向居住在沙特阿拉伯的成年人（≥18岁）发放了一项探索性、横断面、自填式在线调查。纳入所有在过去一年中使用生成式AI工具查找在线健康信息的成年人。采用双变量和多变量分析检验变量之间的关系。共有403名符合条件的健康消费者（58%为男性）参与。在曾将生成式AI用于健康目的的受访者中，约49%报告每月使用超过五次。较年轻的年龄、较高的收入以及就诊前更频繁的使用与更频繁的健康信息查找行为的较高几率相关。头痛、腹痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛是最常见的诉求。ChatGPT是用于查找信息的主要平台（84%）。年龄与频率呈显著负相关，而收入和就诊前使用呈正相关。通过生成式AI查找健康信息的主要原因是快速检索信息（71%）、节省时间（34%）和好奇心（30.5%）。较高的使用频率表明，生成式AI可作为健康信息来源，并可能导致使用者向医疗服务提供者隐瞒健康信息。它可能影响随后的健康求助行为，例如要求紧急就医或推迟就诊。这些自我报告的结果并不能确立诊断准确性、临床有效性或患者安全性，且未评估临床风险以及自我管理行为的适当性。许多受访者报告了对信息不准确、漏诊严重疾病以及健康焦虑加重的担忧。

abstract: [Medical science educator] The pilot comparability study by Josan and colleagues comparing GPT-4-generated and expert-written OSCE standardized patient scripts offers timely insights for medical education. This letter highlights three considerations. First, the "AI-only" arm was not human-free but reflected an expert-supervised iterative loop, suggesting that the key contrast lies in workflow design rather than authorship. Second, the AI+human scripts scored highest in clinical accuracy yet lowest in realism, consistent with evidence that combined human-AI workflows can underperform the stronger party alone, particularly when humans act as final arbiters rather than co-producers. Third, large language models may be better suited to knowledge-intensive, protocol-driven OSCE cases than to communication-heavy scenarios. Future studies should distinguish subject-matter from task-specific editor expertise and develop a case typology to guide appropriate AI deployment.
zh_abstract: Josan 及其同事的预试验可比性研究比较了 GPT-4 生成与专家撰写的 OSCE 标准化病人脚本，为医学教育提供了及时的见解。这封来信强调三点考虑。第一，“仅 AI”组并非没有人的参与，而是体现了专家监督下的迭代循环，提示关键差异在于工作流程设计而非作者身份。第二，AI+人工脚本在临床准确性上得分最高，但在真实感上最低，这与人机结合的工作流程可能表现不如较强一方单独工作的证据一致，尤其是当人类充当最终裁决者而非共同创作者时。第三，大语言模型可能更适合知识密集、遵循规程的 OSCE 病例，而非以沟通为主的情境。未来研究应区分学科内容专业知识与特定任务的编辑者专业知识，并建立病例分类体系，以指导 AI 的恰当应用。
